listing.name: The Darkness (The Darkness Recomp)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Upstream runtime package plus source build for The Darkness Recomp; use own game files per documented setup, with upstream/player owning installation and runtime replacement. Observed release artifacts are evidence, not operational package selection or Portcove support. Limits: Upstream only: Upstream gameplay/audio/save/control claims. Exact executable/localization gates retained; diagnostic ZIP optional, not the player runtime. No Portcove qualification. Windowsx64 D3D11; diagnostic-launcher ZIP differs actual runtime. Source XMA build MSYS2/LLVM prerequisites and generated-code route remain separate. Upstream platforms: Windows10/11 x64 D3D11 runtime ZIP. Development/update build requires VS2022Clang/CMake/Python/MSYS2/LLVM; release play does not. Original data: Own complete extracted Xbox360 TheDarkness game dump: default.xex,Content,System and other matching files. ISO alone insufficient. Original supported executable plus documented Russian localization accepted, hashes validated internally; exact hash values Unknown here. No XexTool preparation needed. No separate consoleBIOS input specified. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
